name: Magnetic Button
description: A button that leans toward the pointer within a radius while its label travels further, giving a sense of depth. Springs back when the pointer leaves.
intents: button that pulls toward the cursor
make one button feel alive on hover
usage: Use for one hero action on a marketing page or empty state. Not for forms, toolbars or dense UI, where moving targets hurt precision. Pass the text as `label` (default "Get started") or `children`, and `onClick(event)`. If the click starts async work, set `loading` until it ends: a spinner shows, the magnet lets go and clicks are ignored. It is a real <button> (`type`, `disabled`, `form`, aria-* and data-* go to it) and the ref is that button. Disabled automatically under reduced motion.

dataProps.description: Button content as a node (an icon and text), instead of `label`. It travels with the label's depth. It sits inline like text; wrap an icon and text in your own inline-flex span to space them.
(event) => void when pressed. Not called while `loading` or `disabled`.
The native button type. Use "submit" inside a <form>.
You own it: set it while the action's async work runs. A spinner shows before the label, aria-busy is set, the button stops following the pointer and clicks are ignored.
Native disabled: not focusable or clickable, dimmed, and the magnet is off.
Other attributes (id, name, value, form, aria-*, data-*, event handlers) go to the <button>; className and style go to the wrapper span.
The <button>: focus it or measure it.
